source.title: Open problems in the general efficiency

trace.notes: Normalized the input as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL with trailing identifier 7033776.

Failure modes: network_or_dns_failure for local shell access to api.zbmath.org, metadata_only for the zbMATH resolver context available through local shard metadata, and metadata_only for exact-title bibliographic records. Local resolver metadata in outputs/shards/open-problems-shard-0.csv identified zbMATH identifier 7033776 as the 2016 work Open problems in the general efficiency, with no full-text links listed.

Ran exact-work recovery attempts using the zbMATH identifier 7033776, the exact title Open problems in the general efficiency, the author name Vasile Postolica, the year 2016, ROMAI Journal, and PDF-focused queries. Search recovered an exact-title CAIM 2016 abstract-book PDF excerpt from romai.ro naming Vasile Postolica and describing the topic, but that excerpt is an abstract rather than a readable full technical source containing the actual open-problem statements. CV and publication-list PDFs confirmed a ROMAI Journal publication in volume 12 number 2, pages 117-141, and EBSCO exposed a bibliographic result for the same title, but these were metadata or author records, not readable full text. The ROMAI Journal archive and indexed neighboring volume 12 number 2 PDFs were inspected by exact path and title searches; no readable Postolica article PDF or full HTML article body for this exact work was recovered within the bounded pass.

No candidates were mapped, extracted, rewritten, deduplicated, or accepted because no readable PDF or HTML full-text artifact could be confirmed and accessed as the same exact zbMATH source. The workflow forbids extracting questions from resolver metadata, author CV entries, bibliographic records, abstracts, search snippets, or neighboring/different works when the technical problem statements are not visible in the chosen source text.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/7033776.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
